name: Calculator
summary: Pocket calculator with a display and a grid of number and operator keys; use for maths, budgets and shop scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the calculator rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the calculator is hero size (about 560 px tall); use about 0.4 next to a hand

params.name: anim
params.note: tap = the equals key is pressed over and over

author: krakujs
